fields.statement: Case create-no-longer-applies (TestParityCreateNoLongerApplies): log = landed create of parent P; draft D creates child C under P; a later landed change set retires P. Write view of D: before, the interim model held C (present); the strict what-if skips D's create (model.ErrRetired) and has no C (absent). The interim side changed: newModelSets now takes its nodes and links from model.AsIsSeed and model.WhatIfFrom, so C is absent.
